coordinate.coordNote: Offisiell adressekoordinat fra Geonorge Adresser API for Monrads gate 12, OSLO. Punktet brukes som display- og unlock-marker for Klimahuset etter fysisk kryssjekk mot den navngitte Klimahuset-bygningen. Det representerer ikke hele Naturhistorisk museum eller Botanisk hage.

representationDecision: Treat Klimahuset as one physically distinct named exhibition building and visitor experience inside the wider Naturhistorisk museum and Botanisk hage campus. The exact Monrads gate 12 Geonorge point lies about 13.2 metres from the named Klimahuset building candidate, strongly supporting the same-building identity. Do not use the broad Sars gate 1 campus address as a proxy, and do not split the exhibition, auditorium or sustainable architecture into overlapping place markers.

duplicateGate.conclusion: Klimahuset is not a duplicate of either broader canonical place. It is a separately named public exhibition building with its own exact address anchor, while Naturhistorisk museum remains the wider institution and Botanisk hage the enclosing garden/campus place.

sourceNotes: Naturhistorisk museum identifies Klimahuset as a dedicated exhibition house for climate and climate change, part of Naturhistorisk museum and located in Botanisk hage.
The building opened to the public in June 2020 after completion in March 2020.
Oslo municipality currently uses Monrads gate 12 as the address for Klimahuset in its public venue information.
Atelier Oslo documents a distinct roughly 700 square metre building for exhibitions and events on climate and climate change.
The exact Geonorge address point is about 13.2 metres from the separately named Klimahuset OSM building candidate, way 762832690.
